paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
model_annotation: The figure presents two vertically stacked line plots comparing the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B under two methods—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—on Easy and Hard training sets, respectively, over 500 training steps. In the top panel (“Easy Training Set”), the x-axis represents “Steps” ranging from 0 to 500 with linear spacing and major ticks every 100 steps; the y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” spans from 0.0 to 0.4 with linear scale and ticks at intervals of 0.1. The teal solid line with circular markers, labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy,” begins near 0.0, rises steeply to approximately 0.2 by step 100, then continues to climb gradually to about 0.35 by step 500, exhibiting moderate noise throughout. The red solid line with circular markers, labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy,” also starts near 0.0, increases rapidly to ~0.2 by step 100, and continues to grow more steadily than the teal line, reaching approximately 0.4 by step 500, with slightly less noise. In the bottom panel (“Hard Training Set”), the x-axis again spans 0 to 500 steps with the same linear scale and tick intervals, while the y-axis ranges from 0.0 to 0.2 with linear scale and ticks at 0.05 intervals. The teal line, “Llama-On-Policy-Hard,” begins near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.05 by step 100, then declines steadily to near 0.0 after step 150 and remains flat for the remainder of training. The red line, “Llama-LUFFY-Hard,” starts near 0.0, climbs gradually to approximately 0.1 by step 200, then continues a slow but steady ascent to about 0.2 by step 500, showing persistent fluctuations throughout. Both plots include shaded regions around each line indicating uncertainty or variance, though the exact nature is not specified. The performance gap between the two methods is visibly larger in the Easy set, where the red line consistently maintains a lead of approximately 0.10 over the teal line, whereas in the Hard set, the lines remain close until after step 200, after which the red line pulls ahead and continues to diverge.
